QuestInfo.name: [Riena Strait] Seal Clubbing
QuestInfo.1: Dabo wants you to beat up all those jerks who are using seals for their evil plans! Eliminate #r100 more Possibly-Evil Seals#k in #bUnderwater Ice Cave 1#k.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated #r100 more Possibly-Evil Seals#k in #bUnderwater Ice Cave 1#k for Dabo.

0.0: I won't let this lot ruin our reputation, I tell ya. I won't!
0.1: 'Course I'm not much of a fighter meself, but you seem to know your way 'round a whackin' stick. Maybe you'd care to take care of #rabout 100 more o' those hoodlums#k?

yes.0: Good luck with them troublemakers! Give 'em one for me!\r\n#b#e(Eliminate #r100 Possibly-Evil Seals#b in Underwater Ice Cave 1.)

no.0: I've come to expect disappointment from humans.

1.0: Did you teach 'em a good lesson?

yes.0: I feel much better now. Might even go on a little diet now... tomorrow.
